summary.text: Your family member must use their Singpass. You can guide them or go with them for help.

steps.name: Use their Singpass
steps.text: Have your family member use their Singpass to sign up for CareShield Life.

steps.name: Apply using the form
steps.text: Guide your family member to apply using the Application to join CareShield Life form.

steps.name: Get help if needed
steps.text: If you are facing difficulties, accompany your family member to a Community Club or Centre to sign up.

example_phrasings: Can I sign up for CareShield Life on behalf of my parent/spouse/sibling?
Can I apply for CareShield Life for a family member?

sources.page_title: Can I sign up for CareShield Life on behalf of my parent/spouse/sibling?

quotes.text: Your family member’s Singpass will be required to sign up for CareShield Life.
You can guide your family member to use his/her Singpass to apply for CareShield Life via the Application to join CareShield Life form.
If they are facing difficulties, you can accompany them to the Community Clubs/Centres to sign up.
